source.title: A Fortuitous Turn of Events
source.description: Well hello <name>! I was just standing here taking in the scenery and I just couldn't help but overhear your predicament. Fortuitously, I think I can provide just what you need to help you with your little "evil devouring nightmare monster" problem.
source.objective: Listen to what the Shadowy Figure has to say.
source.progress:
I must say, this couldn't have worked out better if I had planned it. It seems that fate smiles upon you, friend.

<You get the distinct impression that the shadowy figure before you is smirking>
source.completion: Isn't it encouraging to have someone like me around that tends to have just what you need, just when you need it?
